title: Assignment 1 – Leadership & Emotional Intelligence Reflection
content:
[32601 Advanced Project Management | Assignment 1 – Leadership & Emotional Intelligence Reflection]
- Due: 23 August 2026 at 23:59.
- Weight: 20%.
- Maximum length: 800 words +/-10%.
- Submission: file upload; PDF, DOC or DOCX.

This individual reflection task is designed to develop self-awareness as a foundation for working effectively in teams. Students complete a leadership style survey and an emotional intelligence (EI) assessment, then critically reflect on what the results suggest about their strengths and areas for improvement.

- Use real examples from project, work or professional settings.
- Use relevant theory to support claims and future development plans.
- Select one or two areas for improvement in leadership and emotional intelligence.
- Use a clear paragraph structure when explaining reflections and development plans.
- Attach the leadership and EI assessment results in an appendix.
